summary: Iter 13 — Promo/Combo/Order-discount mutual exclusivity + /api/orders* router extraction. Ran the existing 5 unit tests on _compute_totals + wrote 8 new HTTP integration tests hitting the extracted /api/orders* router (all 13 passing). Frontend UI verified end-to-end on /register: HH banner + HH lock badges, combo lock badges + combo line in totals, exclusivity note, order-level discount base excludes HH/combo lines, save + fire course + cash payment + receipt modal all functional.
critical_code_review_comments: routers/orders.py: `_compute_totals` correctly implements HH -> Combo -> Order-discount precedence and greedy best-combo selection with overlap skipping.
routers/orders.py has no role guard on DELETE (void) is correctly restricted to admin/manager; PATCH/POST/pay open to any authenticated user — acceptable for POS staff.
Frontend `Register.jsx` totals useMemo mirrors backend logic exactly — good parity.
Minor: `deps.py` shared handle keeps orders.py clean; server.py delegates to router — clean split. Consider extracting /api/combos to its own router too (server.py still ~900 lines).
PaymentIn `amount` for split can be 0 while splits sum to total — server correctly validates via `paid + 0.01 < total`; good.
